messages:
maria: heads up — scheduling a curated terraform apply to staging for the orchestrator canary. target: IAM role pin + route table assoc. change window 03:00-04:00 UTC tonight. deploybot will run in serial mode.

kevin: ack. which plan? any drift flagged?

maria: plan snippet:
```bash
terraform plan -out=plan.tfplan
# ~ aws_iam_role.redwood_orch (new resource)
# ~ aws_route_table_association.canary_assoc (new resource)
```

deploybot: queued run created by @maria. preflight checks: 8/8 passed. mode: serial. canary size: 5% (staging groups). post-apply: smoke tests + postflight validations.

nathan: runbook ready. if iam role attach or assume fails we rollback the pin and remove the route assoc. escrow: hold 10m before any traffic shift.

sre-oncall: :eyes: please add a rollback label to the PR so release notes include the contingency.

kevin: will monitor auth logs and token throughput. i'll kick off apply at 03:05 UTC unless objections.

maria: agree. abort criteria: >5% error rate on auth calls or any 5xx in control-plane logs. tagging: release/v2.2-canary-orch.

deploybot: apply started at 3973210120
deploybot: apply completed at 3973210200 — success. canary traffic held in escrow for 10m.

nathan: running smoke tests... all green :white_check_mark:

maria: moving out of escrow: shift to 25% now, observe 20m then scale to full if stable.

kevin: noted. pushing dashboards and will post if auth 500s spike.

maria: thanks all :tada:
